notes.title: Comit remake gets a title and release date
notes.notes:
The Comit the Astrodian remake will be called Comit Legends and will be releasing on March 20th, 2023. The game will include remakes of all previous Comit titles and new modes such as Boss Rush and Speed Run. (The latter will speed up the boost option and allow you to remove enemies if wanted). For the first time ever in the Comit series, local multiplayer will be added featuring split-screen races. (Not sure if Online multiplayer will be a thing yet but I would like it to be if I can pull it off.)
